purpose: Logical host parameters only. Native owns protobuf, session IDs, map IDs, fragments, ACKs, timeouts and page heartbeat.

validation.integers: finite integral platform integers; booleans and floating point are not integers
validation.strings: strict UTF-8 byte lengths; no embedded NUL; no normalization
validation.imageFormat: Whole firmware-format bytes, already encoded for compressMode. No PNG/BMP decoding or LZ4 encoding is implied.

page.totalContainers: derived, 1..12; containerId unique across all arrays; at most one event capture

menuItem.subItems: list<menuSubItem> default[] <=5; IDs unique within list

commands.name: createPage
commands.semantics: Acquires the sole page lease, assigns unique sessionId, starts native heartbeat after ACK.

commands.name: updateImage

parameters.data: required byte array1..1048576, whole firmware-format image

commands.correlation: All echoed metadata fields match current native image fragment. Name may be omitted, but must match when present.

parameters.contentLength: uint32 default UTF8 content byte length

commands.name: rebuildPage
commands.semantics: Replaces current container/menu identity only after confirmed ACK; page session unchanged.

commands.name: shutdownPage
commands.semantics: Queues behind an in-flight owned command; disarms future heartbeat immediately. Mode0 ACK retires page. Mode1 ACK only confirms prompt: awaitingExit=true, page remains active with native heartbeat until exact scoped exit.

commands.name: heartbeat
commands.correlation: Exact native owner, protobuf magic, unique responseOneof15 and success12. Standard responseCmd13 or observed enterprise firmware echo Cmd12; no other command gains request/response aliasing. Request Cnt is omitted/default0; optional uint32 ACK Cnt is not correlation. Native attempted/confirmed counts are local diagnostics; actual rootCmd remains visible in diagnostics.

commands.name: audioControl
commands.success: Native requested target0or1; omitted scalar means0 only inside actual response branch.

commands.name: menuStartupFailed
commands.semantics: One-way response under current whole-pair READY, also before the first CREATE or after page close. Completes after native transport queue admission; not a device ACK. Without a page it creates no page/session or heartbeat; result omits pageSessionId. Reset/disconnect/replacement revoke any unsent tail.

commands.name: imuControl
commands.success: Native requested target0or1; any other status fails.

commands.name: menuSubitemResponse
commands.semantics: One-way response, completes after native transport queue admission; host must answer actual menu switch before firmware10sec deadline.

eventDetails.system: source=unspecified/rightGlasses/ring/leftGlasses; exitReasonCode defaults0; optional widgetId and scoped pageSessionId

events.2/13: recognized list/text/sys, enum0..10, container identity fenced; IMU uses finite float32 x/y/z
events.11/16: privateEvent with recognized container identity and uint32 eventId/eventData
events.14/17: privateSystemEvent with command0 timeoutPageEnter or1 timeoutPageExit and uint32 value; connection-scoped forwarding without a page is allowed only under current whole-pair READY and never changes page ownership
events.17/20: menuStartup with matching widgetId for an active page; without a page, accepts nonzero uint32 widgetId under current whole-pair READY
events.21/24: menuItemClick with known action item ID
events.unpagedOwnership: Exact frozen endpoint/session/attempt required. Startup/diagnostic events and menuStartupFailed use the same monotonic operation sequence as pages; no synthetic pageSessionId. Container/private/custom-menu-click events still require an owned page.
events.terminalExits: Only SysEvent6/7 with exact widgetId AND native page sessionId retire the lease. Unknown enums/oneofs, duplicate singular fields, wrong wire types, malformed UTF8 or CRC are ignored.
